paragraphs.text: The interface becomes a return value.
thinks agents that render real UI inside Slack and Teams will become the main way we work with them. He’s right about the direction.
The plumbing already exists. In January,

became the protocol’s first official extension: a tool can now return an interactive interface that renders inside the conversation. It’s crude, but it changes what an app is. You stop opening a destination. The agent works out of sight and hands you a surface when you need to decide something.

Most of the screenless hardware bets missed the asymmetry. Input is going post-GUI. Output isn’t. Voice is a great way to say what you want and a poor way to judge a dense result. Your eyes are still the widest channel you have.
The question isn’t what the screen looks like anymore. It’s when you need one, and the least it can show.
